shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "=== TREE ===" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && echo "=== PKG ===" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && cat AGENTS.md

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== TABLE ENTRIES ===" && rg -n -C 6 -i 'gravity-ui/table|data grid|uikit.*Table' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo "=== SRC ===" && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo "=== NODE_MODULES ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; echo "=== TRAPS ==="; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table/ build/esm/components/Table/hoc/ build/esm/components/Pagination/ 2>&1; find . -iname 'README.md' -path '*Table*' -o -iname 'README.md' -path '*Pagination*' | head; echo "=== Table.d.ts ==="; cat build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; echo "=== withTableSorting ==="; cat build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; echo "=== withTableSelection ==="; cat build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; echo "=== Pagination ==="; cat build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== index exports ==="; cat build/esm/components/Table/index.d.ts

rg -n 'meta|disableDataSorting|getSortedData|defaultSortOrder' build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -40; echo "=== selection header ==="; rg -n 'Checkbox|disabled|getRowId' build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -20; echo "=== exports ==="; rg -n -o 'Flex|Text|Label|Button|Card' build/esm/components/index.d.ts | sort -u | head; cat build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | rg -n 'theme|size' | head -8
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "vite exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
